name: Satat
description: Satat is a trick-taking card game that involves tricks, trump, following suit. The game originated in Mauritius (related to Indian Seven Hands); name from Hindi "saat hant" (seven hands). Objective: win at least seven of 13 tricks.

Country/Region of Origin: Mauritius
Time Period: Traditional; information from Mauritian source (Satat.net).
Historical Development: Related to the Indian game Seven Hands (Rang/Court Piece); name from Hindi "saat hant" (seven hands). Most popular card game in Mauritius.
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game in Mauritius.
